documents.title: Computer Science AI Policy Tier System
documents.summary: A department-wide framework that every Pomona CS course must place itself in: four tiers ranging from no AI use (Tier 0) through syllabus-defined use (Tier 1), use with attribution (Tier 2), to open use without credit (Tier 3). It frames itself as a pilot to be revisited, focuses on usages rather than named tools, ties misalignment to the departmental honor policy, and acknowledges Harvey Mudd's AI-use course policy as its inspiration.

documents.title: Academic Honesty Policy
documents.summary: The CS department's general academic honesty policy, revised for Fall 2026 to name AI tools as unapproved sources by default and to defer AI-specific rules to the department's AI Policy Tier System. It also covers copying from AI, routine similarity/AI-content detection, citation of permitted AI in papers, a ban on feeding course materials to AI tools, and graduated sanctions.
